title: Let's Learn English Lesson 12
subtitle: Meet My Family
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 12: Meet My Family (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. has many beautiful parks. In fact, this park reminds me of my home very far away.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！華盛頓特區有很多漂亮的公園。其實，這個公園讓我想起很遠的家鄉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm thinking about my family. I'm feeling homesick.
dialogue.zh: 我在想我的家人。我有點想家。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do you want to talk about it?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is my mother and this is my father. They are rodeo clowns.
dialogue.zh: 這是我媽媽，這是我爸爸。他們是牛仔競技小丑。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They make jokes at a rodeo. They make people laugh.
dialogue.zh: 他們在牛仔競技會上講笑話。他們逗人笑。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Who is that woman in the picture?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is my Aunt Lavender. She is my mom's sister. She loves gardening and makes spoons.
dialogue.zh: 那是我的姨媽拉文德。她是我媽媽的姐姐。她喜歡園藝，還做勺子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! This is my Uncle John. He is my father's brother.
dialogue.zh: 哦！這是我的叔叔約翰。他是我爸爸的哥哥。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: He's a chicken farmer. And makes guitars. He's awesome, and I'm his favorite niece.
dialogue.zh: 他是養雞的。還做吉他。他很棒，我是他最喜歡的侄女。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They are my cousins. They are my Uncle John's daughter and son.
dialogue.zh: 他們是我的堂兄弟姐妹。是約翰叔叔的女兒和兒子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They raise sheep and make sweaters.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Thanks for showing me your family photos. Your family is very different.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你給我看家人的照片。你的家人很特別。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I do feel better. Thanks for listening. I have many more photos!
dialogue.zh: 我確實感覺好多了。謝謝你聽我說。我還有很多照片！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington, DC is my new home. But I like remembering my old home, too.
dialogue.zh: 華盛頓特區是我的新家。不過我也喜歡想起我的老家。

quiz.prompt: What do Anna's mother and father do?
